title: Disrupted PQBP1-HNRNPU-LINE-1 axis underlies aberrant neurodevelopment in renpenning syndrome
title_zh: Renpenning综合征中PQBP1-HNRNPU-LINE-1轴失调导致神经发育异常
abstract: Mutations in RNA splicing factor PQBP1 cause Renpenning syndrome (RS), yet whether LINE-1 (L1) contributes to RS pathogenesis remains unclear. Here, we generated human forebrain organoids model carrying a novel patient-derived PQBP1 variant (c.28 C > G; p.R10G), and observed impaired neurogenesis in RS organoids. Bulk and single-cell RNA-sequencing revealed that PQBP1 R10G mutation upregulated evolutionarily ancient L1 expression and induced aberrant L1 splicing, resulting in the redundant production of non-canonical L1-containing transcripts. Mechanistically, disrupted PQBP1-HNRNPU interaction by PQBP1 R10G mutation impaired U1/U2 small nuclear ribonucleoprotein (snRNP) recruitment to splicing sites, leading to increased L1-containing intron retention of neurodevelopmental genes, including WDR11. L1 retention reduced canonical WDR11 transcripts and consequently protein expression. Canonical WDR11, not L1-containing isoform, ameliorated the neurodevelopmental deficits of RS organoids. Together, our findings establish the dysregulated PQBP1-HNRNPU-L1 axis as a pathogenic driver of RS and nominate WDR11 as a potential therapeutic target for RS.
abstract_zh: PQBP1 RNA剪接因子突变导致Renpenning综合征（RS），但LINE-1（L1）在RS病理生成中的贡献尚不明确。本研究利用携带新患者来源PQBP1变异（c.28 C>G; p.R10G）的人类前脑脑器官模型，观察到RS脑器官中神经发生受损。 bulk和单细胞RNA测序揭示，PQBP1 R10G突变上调了进化古老的L1表达并诱导L1异常剪接，导致非典型L1包含转录本的冗余产生。机制上，PQBP1 R10G突变破坏PQBP1-HNRNPU相互作用，导致小核核糖核蛋白（snRNP）U1/U2招募到剪接位受阻，导致包括WDR11在内的神经发育基因内含L1的内含子保留。L1保留减少了WDR11的典型转录本并随后减少蛋白表达。典型的WDR11，而非L1包含的异构体，缓解了RS脑器官的神经发育缺陷。综上，我们的研究确立了失调的PQBP1-HNRNPU-L1轴作为RS的致病驱动因素，并将WDR11提名为RS的潜在治疗靶点。
